title: Sci-Fi
declined: only two cards per version: a set has ten cards
characters: no characters or people (robots and aliens count as characters)

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A symmetrical flying saucer seen from the side, with a round silver disc hull, a clear glass dome on top and a ring of yellow lights around the rim, hovering with no landing legs.
cards.hero_colors: silver, pale green glass dome, yellow rim lights

cards.name: Fljoystick
cards.subject: A flight joystick with a square black base, a tall grey stick and a round red knob on top.
cards.hero_colors: black, grey, red knob

cards.name: Moon Rover
cards.subject: A six-wheeled moon rover with a white boxy body, six black wheels fixed by axles to the body, an orange stripe along the side and a small round dish antenna on a short mast on top, standing on pale dust.
cards.hero_colors: white, black wheels, orange stripe

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A slim rocket flying upward with a white body, a pointed red nose cone, three red fins at the base and a round porthole window, with a bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core and orange flame tips curling downward from the engine.
cards.hero_colors: white, red, grey porthole, yellow-orange flame
